title: Quiz: the system
module: Widgets, Siri, notifications and on-device AI

questions.question: How does Siri perform actions in your app on iOS 27?
questions.why: App Intents is now the way to work with Siri.

questions.question: How often does a widget run its code?

answers.text: When the system asks for a timeline, and when the app asks it to reload

questions.why: Widgets show prepared entries to save battery.

questions.question: What does @Generable let the on-device model do?

answers.text: Fill in an instance of your own Swift type

questions.why: Structured output, with no text parsing.
